atGrafana.configuration.title: AT Grafana
atGrafana.configuration.queryLimits.maxR: Maximum time span, in milliseconds, that a single Agent (MCP) datasource query may cover. A query with a longer `start`..`end` range is narrowed to the most recent span of this length and its result is marked `truncated: true` (reason `time-range`). Default: 43200000 (12 hours).

Maximum size, in bytes, of a single Agent (MCP) datasource query response. A larger response is discarded (never returned partially) and the result is marked `truncated: true` (reason `response-size`). Default: 5242880 (5 MiB).
atGrafana.configuration.alerts.refreshIn: Automatically refresh the Alerts view every this many seconds. `0` (the default) turns auto-refresh off.
